description: VILLASnode is a gateway for exchanging data among real-time power-system simulators, laboratory hardware and software models. RWTH Aachen contributors document connectors for RTDS and OPAL-RT equipment, Simulink, LabVIEW, shared memory, files and network protocols including MQTT, ZeroMQ and IEC 61850 messages. Users configure the participating endpoints, channels and forwarding paths; outputs are live streams passed between simulators during a chosen experiment. Spatial scope and duration follow the connected grid test, with latency constraints important for hardware-in-the-loop use. Source and configuration files are publicly available; most files use Apache-2.0, while per-file SPDX tags identify other open licences. A limitation is that supported connectors do not guarantee timing or semantic compatibility with every simulator; deployment needs appropriate drivers and equipment. It serves distributed grid co-simulation and digital-twin studies. The catalogue's model-dpsim explicitly mentions VILLASnode coupling, but represents a distinct grid solver. No gateway or laboratory hardware was run.
